errata.dedup_scope: Descriptive only: identical, German paraphrase, cross-language negative. All negatives cross-language; threshold0.95 is uncalibrated across models. Jina text-matching is not product retrieval dedup.

primary_runner.status: Historical exact runner; its exit0 was not success. Original Small-r0 failed before inference; repeats1/2 unattempted. Six Nano/BGE repetitions succeeded.

errata.deadline: Original and corrected supervisor enforce1800s per candidate across its three repetitions (stricter than worker_wall_limit_seconds suggests); canonical900s per candidate. No thresholds relaxed.
errata.resource_scope: Only sampled process-tree RSS (.5s) and per-stage end-to-end walls are comparable with caveats. BGE Ollama HTTP/Q8_0 and Jina in-process float32 differ. BGE lazy model load is included in first query, Jina model load in load stage. CPU samples can miss exiting children; no CPU-efficiency, concurrency-capacity or SLA claim.

bootstrap.method: query-paired percentile95% CI on candidate-minus-BGE; all_required@k and MRR primary; original and independent supplement separate; missing pairs retained, not imputed.
